# 因明入正理論直解

**Category:** 論集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋論部／因明論疏
**Byline:** 明 智旭述
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1

## Contributors
- 智旭 (A001257)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The last and most influential of the late-Míng commentaries on the *Rù lùn* [KR6o0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0003), in one *juǎn*, by [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) (Zhìxù / Ǒuyì 蕅益, 1599–1655), the great late-Míng Buddhist polymath. The colophon "古吳蕅益釋智旭述" identifies the author as "Shì Zhìxù of Gǔwú [Sūzhōu], style-name Ǒuyì". The *Zhí jiě* divides the *Rù lùn* into a careful tripartite outline (解題 / 出論主 / 出譯師, then a section-by-section commentary) and proceeds with characteristic Ǒuyì rigour and clarity. It became the standard textbook of Buddhist logic in the early Qīng and Republican periods, far more widely read than any other Míng-Qīng treatment.

**Abstract**

The text opens with a careful three-part outline of the title-explanation: (1) the title proper (正解論題), (2) identifying the author (出論主), and (3) identifying the translator (出譯師). The body then follows the *Rù lùn* lemma by lemma. Zhìxù draws upon all the available earlier Míng commentaries — Zhēnjiè [KR6o0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0026), Wáng Kěntáng [KR6o0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0027), Míngyù [KR6o0028](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0028) — but goes back to first principles to recover the structural skeleton of Indian *yīnmíng* doctrine. The Yogācāra-Tiāntái-Chán-Pure-Land syncretism that characterises Zhìxù's larger oeuvre is here held in restraint; the *Zhí jiě* is a deliberately sober and technical exposition. Composition is placed in Zhìxù's mature period, c. 1635–1655 (he died in 1655). The Xuzangjing transmits from a late-Míng or early-Qīng print.
